name: Shape letters
what: A phrase types in, but some letters are small coloured shapes - a triangle, a circle, a square - that spin in where the letter would be, bob while it holds, and turn back into their letters at the end.

learned_from.what: a phrase typing in with letters replaced by a red triangle and a blue dot

motion: 14 letters a second; shapes spin in back.out 10 f, bob 14 f; back to letters back.out 10 f
